summary: This theme explores the multifaceted role of generative AI and LLMs in language education, emphasizing their impact on engagement, confidence, autonomy, and personalized learning, while addressing challenges like critical literacy, ethical use, and pedagogical shifts.

This theme focuses on the role of AI-driven feedback in language education, particularly in writing and assessment, highlighting benefits like immediacy and personalization, alongside challenges such as over-reliance and cognitive load.

This theme highlights how large language models improve writing proficiency, confidence, and motivation through self-regulated learning and metacognitive awareness, while raising concerns about over-reliance.
This theme addresses the negative consequences of excessive dependence on AI in language learning, including reduced critical thinking, academic dishonesty, and inequitable outcomes.
